payload.text: (2026-09-17, hv first-hand, in three answers to vc's questions) Three rulings for ST0076. (1) The level-3 verb's name `intent index resolve` is agreed. (2) Tests that need a real toolchain, verbatim: "Outside CI/CD for now BUT they MUST run here when the 'fullcycle' and 'test all' dvb commands are run"; vc's wording of the mechanism is in vc decision 25 and wip.md (`#[ignore]` under a module path containing needs_the_toolchain, failing by name when the tool is absent, and a devbin test option that runs only those). (3) The canon _CLAUDE.md template gains one line telling a session to load mcp__intent__intent_search through ToolSearch and ask it before grep, verbatim: "Yes, obvs."; vc's measurement behind it is that the MCP server's instructions are delivered and not followed, a fresh session reaching the index first in one run of three without such a line and three of three with it, and AC-00.1's third clause is satisfied by three fresh runs that all reach the index first with the line in the real CLAUDE.md. hv also said Ok to taking the level-3 population question (whether references only the toolchain sees are stored) as a later decision.
